RUS_ip_select_region_0 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_region = 0 }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_selected = RUS_ip_r0_selected }
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_restart_armed
		RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_select_region_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_region = 1 }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_selected = RUS_ip_r1_selected }
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_restart_armed
		RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_select_region_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_region = 2 }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_selected = RUS_ip_r2_selected }
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_restart_armed
		RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_select_region_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_region = 3 }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_selected = RUS_ip_r3_selected }
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_restart_armed
		RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_select_region_4 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_region = 4 }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_selected = RUS_ip_r4_selected }
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_restart_armed
		RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_select_region_5 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_region = 5 }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_selected = RUS_ip_r5_selected }
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_restart_armed
		RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_open_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_factory_initialized }
			}
			RUS_ip_initialize = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_restart_armed
		RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_enable_gui = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = RUS
			is_ai = no
		}
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_ui_unlocked
		RUS_ip_open_effect = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_close_effect = {
	clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
	clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
	clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_restart_armed
}

RUS_ip_toggle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			}
			RUS_ip_close_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			RUS_ip_open_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

RUS_ip_toggle_help = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
			}
			clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
		}
		else = {
			set_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
		}
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_restart_armed
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_dirty = 1 }
	}
}

RUS_ip_build_page_0 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_build_page = 0 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_dirty = 1 }
	}
}

RUS_ip_build_page_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_build_page = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_dirty = 1 }
	}
}

RUS_ip_start = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_editing = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_started }
		}
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_started
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_active
		RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	}
}

		set_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_machine_output = RUS_ip_r5_available_amount }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_constraint = 3 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_r5_machine_output min = 0 max = 100000 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_shortfall = RUS_ip_r5_machine_rate }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_shortfall = RUS_ip_r5_machine_output }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_shortfall > 0.0001 }
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_bottleneck = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_bottleneck = RUS_ip_r5_constraint }
	}
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_consumed = RUS_ip_r5_machine_output }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_consumed = 2 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_next_steel = RUS_ip_r5_consumed }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_r5_next_steel min = 0 max = 100000 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_consumed = RUS_ip_r5_machine_output }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_consumed = 1 }
	subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_power_left = RUS_ip_r5_consumed }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_r5_power_left min = 0 max = 100000 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_full_power = RUS_ip_r5_machine_rate }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_full_power = 1 }

	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_next_machines = RUS_ip_r5_machine_output }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_output_value = RUS_ip_r5_machine_output }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_output_value = 1 }

	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_next_value = RUS_ip_r5_output_value }
	if = {

			check_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_machine_capacity = 0 }
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_r5_precision_tools_capacity = 0 }
		}

	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_r5_next_coal min = 0 max = 1000000 }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_r5_next_iron min = 0 max = 1000000 }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_r5_next_steel min = 0 max = 1000000 }

	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_r5_next_tungsten min = 0 max = 1000000 }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_r5_next_oil min = 0 max = 1000000 }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_r5_next_aluminium min = 0 max = 1000000 }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_r5_next_alloy min = 0 max = 1000000 }

RUS_ip_arm_restart = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
		}
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_restart_armed
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_dirty = 1 }
	}
}

RUS_ip_confirm_restart = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_restart_armed
		}
		RUS_ip_initialize = yes
	}
}
